Title: What Vamps can you play Masters on?

Messages.Author: David Michael Kass
Messages.Body:
There are several master cards that do not indicate what types of
vampires (I'm referring to the location of the vamp: ready, in
torpor, or uncotrolled) they can be played on. While I can't come up
with reasons for playing all of the cards on all types of vampires,
there is a lot of ambiguity. Here are the cards I could find. I
hope there is some general principle that can be used. Many of the
other cards do say uncontrolled, in torpor, ready or controlled.
These I assume are only on ready vampires (using the ruling from a
long time ago, that masters can only be played on ready vampires).

Aching Beauty
Gangrel De-evolution
Golconda--Inner Peace
Misdirection
Skills (all of them)
Society of Leopold
Temptation of Greater Power
Tragic Love Affair

I'm sure there are others, but these were the ones I own.

David Kass

controlled is defined in the book.

Messages.Author: Tom Wylie
Messages.Body:
Cards can never be played on uncontrolled vampires unless they
specifically say so (e.g. Brainwash).
